analyst.summary: Elecon makes industrial gearboxes and material-handling equipment for power, cement, steel and mining customers, and the underlying business - operating margins, deleveraging, promoter commitment - looks steady. The scary-looking ~33% profit decline over the past year appears to be substantially explained by an unusually high tax charge in one quarter (about 85% of pre-tax profit versus a normal ~24%) rather than the core gearbox/MHE business actually deteriorating, though revenue growth has genuinely slowed versus its multi-year trend. We rate this a Hold and are flagging the tax-driven distortion for the desk so the weak trailing growth number is read in the right context.
